request: build.command 磁盘预检失败，回收确认可重建的旧缓存并实际跑通构建启动；用户补充：镜像编译完除了必要的编译依赖其他的过时产物都删掉，注意自动编译回收；另明确要求清理 Docker Desktop 中无用镜像与卷
acceptance: Free enough disk space without deleting volumes, workspace or referenced images
Real macOS build.command compiles and starts the verified current source
After healthy startup automatically remove unreferenced scoped obsolete slim runtime images including dangling IDs
Preserve current/foreign/referenced images, configured dependency images, development toolboxes and compilation/download cache mounts
Low-disk preflight attempts the same scoped recovery then rechecks; failed build/start never enters post-build recycling
A cleanup failure is reported and does not turn a healthy successful build into a compilation failure
scope: Scoped local Docker cache/obsolete artifact recovery; no global prune or volume deletion
One-time explicit inventory of legacy unused Go-cache volumes; preserve credential/data/report volumes

requirements.summary: User explicitly authorized obsolete-build-output cleanup and automatic recycling; preserve necessary build inputs and operational references.

design.summary: Reuse installation ownership and health verification. Recycle only owned slim runtime outputs, recheck container/tag references without forced image removal, retain named dependencies/toolboxes and exec cache mounts. Scope to POSIX launcher used on this Mac; native Windows and isolated selfdev A/B are unchanged.

implementation.summary: POSIX launcher now recycles scoped obsolete runtime image tags/dangling IDs and old regular cache after verified healthy handover. Low-disk preflight retries after the same scoped recovery; reference/dependency/default-builder safeguards retained.

verification.summary: 33 launcher contract tests passed, including delayed healthy status and bounded timeout. First actual build.command compiled and started successfully; revealed Docker health marker delay before recycling. Added wait and regression; rerun final actual lifecycle and quick after fix.

documentation.summary: Documented automatic recycling, protection boundaries, failure behavior and POSIX-only scope.

cleanup.summary: Initial scoped cache recovery reclaimed 8.761 GB. Keep actual post-build cleanup evidence and confirm live service/data references unchanged.

release_authorization: User requested actual build recovery plus automatic recycling after compilation in this turn.
rollback: Failed compilation/start leaves previous images untouched; after successful recycling obsolete unreferenced outputs are intentionally removed and can be rebuilt. Data/volumes remain.
handoff: Old private regular cache recovery already reclaimed 8.761 GB; finish focused tests, actual build.command and verify automatic recycling.
